style.styleTitle: Personalised Layered Carousel First Christmas Baby Details Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: A beautiful glass bauble containing a personalised layered wooden carousel amongst a scattering of artificial snow. This is a perfect bauble for a baby’s First Christmas, each layer of the design is cut from wood and printed with the illustrated design and personalisation. There is space on the white horse in the centre of the carousel for the child’s name and surname and then further personalised with a line of text on the carousel ‘tent’ at the top and the base at the bottom. The line of text at the top of the decoration is a perfect space for a simple message such as “First Christmas” and the year and the space at the bottom is ideal for including details such as the date and weight. The text will be printed exactly as you enter in the personalisation fields on the order form and nothing will be included/added as standard. The bauble measures approximately 10 x 10cm.
